label: Bible Study
prompt: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the _____ God.
verse: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
note: Peter's great confession at Caesarea Philippi — Jesus blessed him for it on the spot.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Comfort your _____, and stablish you in every good word and work.
verse: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
note: Paul's prayer: that God would comfort your hearts and make you steady in every good word and work.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the _____ heaven.
verse: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
note: Paul, modestly in the third person, describes a man caught up to the third heaven — and admits he can't say how.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be _____, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verse: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
note: The disciples asked who'd be greatest; Jesus set a child in the middle and changed the question entirely.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor _____; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verse: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
note: The Servant had 'no form nor comeliness' — nothing in his looks to draw a crowd.
